policies.text: Accelerated harbor docking privileges are extended to any water transport operator with a maritime safety rating of at least 90 percent.
Primary freight status is conferred upon any transit company maintaining an on-time delivery rate of at least 95 percent this year.
Eco-friendly transit certification is awarded to a coach operator maintaining average passenger emissions under 50 grams per kilometer.
Executive air charter priority is designated to any flight vendor maintaining an active fleet size of at least 10 aircraft.
International customs exemption is granted to any import freight forwarder holding a verified border security permit.
Key route classification is granted to any passenger railway that covers a regional track length of at least 1000 kilometers.
